text:
**Failure mode:** Batch / iteration leak. Step 3 makes one Run loop over all 17 underperforming suppliers inside a single Enterprise Browser session. The AOP also has a decomposition problem (see the note under Fix), but the loop is what caused this failure.

**Where it went wrong:** Transcript [5]-[7], inside AOP Step 3 ("For each supplier under 90%, sign in to their portal with Enterprise Browser..."). The Run had already spent 55 minutes working through suppliers serially. At supplier 9 of 17 (Agrofert) the browser session hit its time limit and the login failed. The expired session is the symptom. The cause is that the AOP puts all 17 portal sign-ins and downloads into one long-lived session. Even with a retry, a Run shaped this way will keep running into the session limit whenever many suppliers fall under 90%. Eight suppliers were left unprocessed, and Steps 4-11 never ran.

**Evidence:**
- AOP Step 3: "For each supplier under 90%, sign in to their portal with **Enterprise Browser** and download open-order status."
- Transcript [2]: `{"suppliers": 84, "under_90": 17}`
- Transcript [5]: "Signing in to portal 9 of 17 (Agrofert)."
- Transcript [7]: "ERROR: browser session expired after 55 minutes"

**Fix:** Rewrite the AOP so one Run handles one supplier. Step 1-2 (Snowflake query and scorecard) becomes a scan that creates a case per supplier under 90%. The per-supplier steps (portal download, email draft, Gmail send) move into a case-driven procedure that opens its own browser session and ends with `complete_case` or `postpone_case`. The platform then iterates over the 17 cases, so no single session has to last through all of them.

The same AOP also has 11 steps and a "next week" wait in Step 6, so it likely wants a further split into a weekly scan and a per-supplier follow-up. I'd treat that as a second pass, not part of this fix.

**Next step:** I can invoke `aop-writer` with Build `bld_w02`, working in `aops/<agent-id>.md`, and the request: "Rewrite Step 3 onward to handle a single supplier per case (portal download, email draft, send), end with `complete_case` or `postpone_case`, and move the weekly scan into its own Agent that creates the cases."

**Caveats:** The transcript starts at [1] and shows no portal work for suppliers 1-8, even though the Run said it was on supplier 9. So I can't confirm from this excerpt that those eight were fully processed. I also can't tell from the excerpt what the Enterprise Browser's session limit is, beyond the 55 minutes in the error. If the full transcript shows earlier re-logins or slow page loads, that would support the same conclusion.

{"failure_mode": "batch_leak", "fix_target": "aop_change", "confidence": 0.6}
